# The tools Atlassian's Rovo MCP server (v2, tools=all) documents for Jira, Confluence and Jira Service Management Operations, from
# support.atlassian.com/atlassian-rovo-mcp-server/docs/supported-tools and atlassian/atlassian-mcp-server. One server answers every
# product, so a Jira connection and a Confluence connection see the same tools. Reads are the read_ and search_ permission groups,
# the Jira ones as Firefight names them. Each line is a tool and whether it only reads or changes something.
